products.definition: DDS75-LB is a LoRaWAN ultrasonic distance detection sensor designed to measure the distance between the sensor and a flat object.
products.uses: DDS75-LB can be used for distance measurement, liquid-level measurement, parking or proximity detection, and bin-level monitoring.
products.suitability: DDS75-LB is suited to projects that need ultrasonic distance measurement of a flat target and can use LoRaWAN connectivity. It can be used for applications such as liquid-level monitoring, parking or proximity detection, and bin-level monitoring.
buyerChecks: Confirm that the required measurement distance fits the stated 280–7500 mm flat-object range.
Confirm that the target and measurement arrangement are appropriate for flat-object ultrasonic sensing.
Select the LoRaWAN regional frequency variant required for the deployment.
Confirm that the 40° measurement angle is appropriate for the installation.
Check any project-specific installation or environmental requirement before ordering.

products.definition: SW3L-004 is a LoRaWAN water-flow sensor record using a DW-004 flow sensor with a G1/2 / DN15 connection.
products.uses: SW3L-004 can be used for flow sensing, water control, toilet flow sensing, and wastewater monitoring.
products.suitability: SW3L-004 is suited to projects that need water-flow monitoring through LoRaWAN and can use a DW-004 G1/2 / DN15 sensor arrangement.
buyerChecks: Confirm that the installation matches the DW-004 G1/2 / DN15 flow-sensor connection.
Confirm that the 450 pulses per litre measurement relationship fits the metering requirement.
Confirm the required LoRaWAN regional frequency band and reporting interval.
Check the installation environment and flow conditions before ordering.

products.definition: S31-LB is a LoRaWAN temperature and humidity sensor with an external 3-metre SHT31 probe.
products.uses: S31-LB can be used for temperature and humidity measurement in building automation, industrial monitoring, automated meter reading, security systems, and irrigation applications.
products.suitability: S31-LB is suited to projects that need combined temperature and relative-humidity measurement from a 3-metre external probe using LoRaWAN.
buyerChecks: Confirm that both temperature and relative humidity are required.
Confirm that the 3-metre external SHT31 probe suits the installation.
Check the stated -40 C to 80 C measurement range and IP66 enclosure against the environment.
Select the required LoRaWAN regional frequency variant and confirm the battery configuration.

products.definition: D20S-LB is a LoRaWAN outdoor temperature sensor using a 2-metre DS18B20 temperature probe.
products.uses: D20S-LB is used to measure temperature and send the reading to an IoT platform through LoRaWAN.
products.suitability: D20S-LB is suited to projects that need outdoor temperature monitoring with the listed 2-metre probe and LoRaWAN connectivity.
buyerChecks: Confirm that the 2-metre DS18B20 probe and buried-type arrangement suit the installation.
Check the stated -55 C to 125 C measurement range and accuracy information for the requirement.
Confirm that the IP66 enclosure and selected battery configuration fit the environment.
Select the required LoRaWAN regional frequency variant.

products.definition: SDI-12-LB is a LoRaWAN converter that connects SDI-12 sensors and sends their environmental readings over LoRaWAN.
products.uses: SDI-12-LB can be used in smart agriculture and weather-station sensor deployments.
products.suitability: SDI-12-LB is suited to projects that need to connect an SDI-12 sensor, provide its supported power output, and send the sensor data through LoRaWAN.
buyerChecks: Confirm that the external sensor uses the SDI-12 protocol.
Confirm whether the sensor requires the controllable 5 V or 12 V output.
Select the LoRaWAN regional frequency variant and the required LB battery configuration.
Check the sensor wiring, power demand, and data requirements before ordering.

products.definition: PS-LB-Dxx is a LoRaWAN differential pressure sensor that measures the pressure difference between two inputs.
products.uses: PS-LB-Dxx can be used for indoor air control and filter-clogging detection.
products.suitability: PS-LB-Dxx is suited to projects that need differential-pressure monitoring over LoRaWAN and can select the pressure range required by the installation.
buyerChecks: Confirm that the project needs differential pressure between two inputs rather than absolute pressure.
Confirm the exact pressure range required for the selected configuration before ordering.
Check that the two pressure-input arrangement suits the measurement points, such as before and after a valve.
Select the required LoRaWAN regional frequency variant and confirm the installation environment.

products.definition: RS485-LN is an RS485 and Modbus to LoRaWAN converter for sending data from RS485 devices to a LoRaWAN server.
products.uses: RS485-LN can be used for monitoring and control in irrigation, smart metering, building automation, smart cities, and industrial or factory systems.
products.suitability: RS485-LN is suited to projects that need to monitor or control RS485 or Modbus devices through LoRaWAN and can provide the external 7-24 V DC input.
buyerChecks: Confirm that the equipment uses the required RS485 interface and supported Modbus or command structure.
Confirm the polling, uplink, and downlink commands required by the connected devices.
Check the external 7-24 V DC power requirement and the required LoRaWAN frequency band.
Confirm whether the deployment needs Class C downlink behavior.

products.definition: WQS-LB is a LoRaWAN water-quality sensor converter main unit that supports one to three water-quality probes.
products.uses: WQS-LB is used to monitor water-quality parameters from supported EC, pH, DO, ORP, TS, CL, or COD probes and upload the readings through LoRaWAN.
products.suitability: WQS-LB is suited to water-quality projects that need a LoRaWAN main unit and can select compatible probes for tap water, industrial water, environmental water, or wastewater monitoring.
buyerChecks: Confirm which supported water-quality parameters the project needs to measure.
Select compatible probes and confirm whether one, two, or three probes are required.
Confirm the LoRaWAN regional frequency variant and the probe installation arrangement.
Check probe wiring, calibration, and environmental requirements before ordering.

products.definition: LPS8N is an indoor LoRaWAN gateway that bridges LoRa wireless networks to an IP network through WiFi or Ethernet.
products.uses: LPS8N can be used as an indoor LoRaWAN gateway in smart buildings, logistics, metering, agriculture, smart cities, and industrial or factory deployments.
products.suitability: LPS8N is suited to indoor projects that need a LoRaWAN gateway and can provide the required WiFi or Ethernet IP backhaul.
buyerChecks: Confirm that an indoor gateway meets the deployment requirement.
Confirm whether WiFi or Ethernet provides the required IP backhaul.
Select the LoRaWAN frequency band configured for the deployment region.
Check the required gateway capacity and network management, and confirm whether the optional cellular version is required.
